'''Demp grenades''' were explosives designed to disable all energy weapons and equipment, leaving them without power. They generally retailed for 800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Droids with [[Ion shield/Legends|ion shielding]] could withstand the effects of a demp grenade.
